title: Transcripts have one reader
body:
(after S2). Outcome: `src/harness/transcripts.ts` locates and iterates transcripts; `src/outcome/ledger.ts` uses it. Proof: the ledger's window equals the previous output to the cent; a rule test counts readers outside `src/harness`. `spend-window.py` stays until t-1ztrn2c closes: its proof names that script. About 2 points.
